title: Secrets and keys: what must never reach the repository

videos.script: A portfolio project is public. Everything in it, and everything that was ever in it, can be read by anybody, including automated programs that search public repositories for keys all day. {{public}} A password committed and then deleted in the next commit is still there, one command away. That is the one fact this lesson exists to make impossible to forget. {{still}} First, what counts as a secret, and where loanbook keeps its configuration. Then a password is committed on purpose, deleted, and found again. It ends with what to do on the day it happens to you, and a hook that stops it happening in the first place.
